report:
Verified on the base: the brief's file-scope rule (goal 5: diff may touch only `prismaquant/digests.py` and `tests/test_digest_profiles_1301.py`) contradicts goals 0, 1 and 6 (which all require editing `prismaquant/digests.py`). `tests/test_guarded_read_digest_retention_2637.py` lines 57-60 pin the current `prismaquant/digests.py` as a (Git blob, SHA-256) pair in `CURRENT_SOURCE_BLOBS` (`65c98d3bdeb16035ef4b104dc159e986e2279897`, `732c5e8e8774491f190eb866f6005ed3014d4fe16c1f2d837f22a39215e90f18`). `_manifest_calls()` (lines 138-170) re-reads each file in `MANIFEST_SOURCE_BLOBS`, which includes `prismaquant/digests.py`, and asserts its live hashes equal `CURRENT_SOURCE_BLOBS[rel]`, failing with "stale manifest source: prismaquant/digests.py" otherwise. Every byte change to `digests.py` (new functions, new `JsonProfile` constant, docstring) therefore breaks: `test_retained_sites_keep_raw_hashlib`, `test_manifest_records_no_exact_owner`, `test_manifest_keeps_gap_dispositions`, `test_manifest_refuses_stale_caller_or_owner` (all 4 params; it calls `_manifest_calls()` before mutating), `test_retention_pin_rejects_recipe_gaps` (24 params) and `test_retention_pin_rejects_unbound_evidence` (5 params). The repo's own precedent is to admit an additive owner change by updating only the `CURRENT_SOURCE_BLOBS` entry: the `prismaquant/tensor_digests.py` entry at lines 44-48 carries the comment "#2638/#3012: additive token recipe; existing owner profiles unchanged", and `tests/test_tensor_digest_owner_recipes_2638.py::test_token_route_has_a_reviewed_current_owner_pin` enforces exactly that pattern (historical `MANIFEST_SOURCE_BLOBS` untouched, `CURRENT_SOURCE_BLOBS` equals the live file). The census JSON `docs/audits/digest_site_census_pq1301_2026-10-04.json` only references the historical `MANIFEST_SOURCE_BLOBS` identity and the `CURRENT_SOURCE_BLOBS` symbol name, so it would not need editing. `tests/test_guarded_read_digest_retention_2637.py` matches no protected_paths pattern.

Unresolved design question for Rob (lands_on_its_own / no_design_questions are both false until answered): may this leaf also edit the `prismaquant/digests.py` entry in `CURRENT_SOURCE_BLOBS` in `tests/test_guarded_read_digest_retention_2637.py` (set it to the new file's Git blob and SHA-256 with an additive-change comment, leaving `MANIFEST_SOURCE_BLOBS` and the census JSON untouched, following the #2638 precedent)? The maker can obtain the new pair without a shell: after editing `digests.py`, run `tests/test_guarded_read_digest_retention_2637.py::test_manifest_refuses_stale_caller_or_owner` and read the live (blob, sha256) tuple from pytest's assertion diff, then re-run until green. If Rob says yes, the plan is one leaf with files `prismaquant/digests.py`, `tests/test_digest_profiles_1301.py`, `tests/test_guarded_read_digest_retention_2637.py`; demonstrating checks are the new tests in `tests/test_digest_profiles_1301.py` (raw SHA-256/blake2b byte pins and lengths, `bytes.fromhex(bytes_sha256hex(x)) == bytes_sha256(x)`, monkeypatched `hashlib.sha256` hit, `DIRECT_ASCII_SPACED_LAX_DEFAULT_REPR` text/encoded/sha256 vs `json.dumps(..., default=repr)` through `outcome()`, new pairs in `test_profiles_are_not_interchangeable`, the 11→12 count edit in `test_profile_names_are_unique`, and the extended `test_digests_imports_only_the_standard_library`); regression checks are `tests/test_digest_profiles_1301.py::test_profile_bytes_are_pinned`, `::test_round_trip_keeps_its_bytes`, `::test_site_keeps_its_bytes_and_refusals`, `::test_binding_is_the_profile_method`, all of `tests/test_guarded_read_digest_retention_2637.py` (named tests above plus `test_manifest_refuses_wrong_provenance`, `test_manifest_refuses_missing_refresh`, `test_manifest_refuses_rewritten_snapshot_identity`, `test_manifest_requires_reviewed_integration_source`), `tests/test_tensor_digest_owner_recipes_2638.py::test_token_route_has_a_reviewed_current_owner_pin`, and `tests/test_duplication_baseline.py::test_the_digest_site_ratchet_fails_on_a_new_raw_site_and_passes_the_owner` (confirmed: the inventory does not ratchet raw hashlib calls inside `prismaquant/digests.py`, lines 124-139). Goal 5's reviewer judgment would then become: diff touches exactly those three files, no caller routed, no export renamed/moved/removed, no golden fixture or census JSON edited, `MANIFEST_SOURCE_BLOBS` unchanged, `CURRENT_SOURCE_BLOBS` digests entry updated additively. If Rob says no, goals 0, 1 and 6 cannot be met without leaving the named retention tests red. Also confirmed from findings: `prismaquant/dev_mode.py::_shown` uses `json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, default=repr).encode()`, whose defaults match the proposed profile options. Still unverified outside facts from the issue (not checkable here): PR #3139, the `tl3-pilot` label, and the identity of the "six named tests".
